title: FM-1c: Monitor AI Chat Panel
summary: AI chat panel integration on FlowMonitorPage. Extends existing wizard SSE endpoint with execution context (MONITOR mode system prompt). Proactive analysis for error/waiting executions. Accept/Reject flow changes with direct save (creates new version). Zustand store extended with AI chat state.
verification_questions: Q1: Does the MONITOR mode system prompt correctly include both flow config and execution trace context?
Q2: Is tenant isolation preserved — does the AI chat only access execution data for the authenticated tenant?
Q3: Does the proactive analysis only trigger for error/waiting statuses and not re-trigger for the same execution?
Q4: Does acceptAiChanges correctly save via api.updateFlow (which triggers versioning) and handle errors?
Q5: Are streaming code blocks (flowconfig/options/json) properly stripped from display text?
intentional_exclusions: No separate wizard history storage for monitor chat — messages are ephemeral per session
No new error codes — reuses existing wizard error codes (INV-BE-070..074)
No new DB tables or migrations — reuses existing wizard endpoint + flow save endpoint
Execution context is passed as raw JSON string to system prompt — no structured DTO needed
